title: RaffeSDG: Random Frequency Filtering enabled Single-source Domain Generalization for Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Random frequency-filter augmentation with blending of homologous samples, plus Gaussian-filter structural saliency for consistent representations across augmented views.
evidence: R: improved out-of-domain segmentation for three tissues imaged by four modalities.
adaptation: Restrict random filtering below about 1/16 px^-1 so crack bands survive; compare with GIN as the single-source DG choice for E1.
min_experiment: Run only if GIN-IPA shows a signal. Arm: house + RaffeSDG. Baseline: house + GIN. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: not better than GIN by 0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Restrict random filtering to frequencies below about 1/16 px^-1 so 4 px crack bands stay intact; run only if GIN shows a signal.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + RaffeSDG augmentation, 5 seeds. Baselines: house and GIN arm. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: not better than GIN by 0.02.
